title: Guard explicit recipe recovery across runs
changes: Allow explicit recipe checkpoint rebinding after a session restart for guest-only recipes when completed operations are followed only by unsent actions; retain old identities and guard the first new request against the recorded paused guest boundary, active cheats and retained collectors.
Bind the guard to the request fingerprint, require a compatible runtime before dispatch, and refuse unresolved requests, expired deadlines, waits and recipes containing host-dependent operations.
validation: Linux synthetic regression: 30 recipe, 35 local-control, 4 completion and 4 operation-registry tests passed, including new cross-run identity, refusal, boundary and old-runtime checks.
Windows GNU test compilation stopped before compiling project code because x86_64-w64-mingw32-dlltool is absent; failed diagnostics were retained.
limitations: No real cross-restart session, Windows/Wine, physical input or full host-context recovery is verified; unresolved pending requests and wait/collector/selection continuations remain refused. The existing 120-second deadline is not extended.
